messages:
Ashwin: Heads up — during today's 16:00 release window the deploy-bot hit an auth failure while trying to assume the prod-deployer role. MFA rotation likely. Need quick decision: who can press, or do we rollback/pin? Logs below. @Maria :eyes:

deploy-bot: ERROR acquiring temp creds: 403 MFA_REQUIRED for role prod-deployer. Cmd: `assume-role --role prod-deployer --session deploy-bot`

Maria: Looping SRE oncall and security. @sre-oncall @security-bot please confirm if a breakglass/delegate token is available and the process to grant it.

sre-oncall: Checked — no breakglass token currently; previous delegate expired during the scheduled rotation window. We can issue a temporary delegate for 20m but need security signoff and an audit ticket. :warning:

security-bot: Security: we can issue a one-time delegated role but require an audit entry + approver confirmation via Slack. Who can be the approver? Recommend @Kevin. :lock:

Kevin: I can approve and press if we agree constraints: short TTL, recorded audit, and prefer pinning to last known-good sha and running a canary instead of full rollout. Pining reduces blast radius.

Lola: Pin + canary sounds right. Suggest pin to `sha:abc123def` (last successful canary) and run a 5% canary. Release notes should call out the MFA rotation event and the rollback plan in runbook 3.2.

Maria: Agreed. @Kevin you have approver rights for this action. Security, please create the one-time delegate and add the audit entry. SRE, prep canary monitors and abort thresholds (error rate >2% or latency >+300ms).

security-bot: Audit ticket created: SEC-2026-128. Delegate TTL=20m. Approver=Kevin. Link: https://tracker.internal/SEC-2026-128 :lock: :white_check_mark:

Kevin: Pressing now. Command I'm running:
```
rdeployer release --pin sha:abc123def --env prod --canary 0.05 --approver kevin
```
Will watch logs and abort if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: manual run accepted (approver=kevin). Canary started (5% traffic). Logs streaming to `stream/SEC-2026-128/1`.

sre-oncall: Canary metrics at +120s: p95 latency +40ms, error rate 0.2%. No anomalies so far. Monitoring alert hooks armed. :thumbsup:

Maria: Good work. If the next 10m stays green we can continue the rollout. Document this incident in the release notes and schedule a follow-up to verify the deployer MFA rotation settings in config infra. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
